previous.changeLog: Added optional Auto Renew for Personal Reserves, with persistent settings and notification buttons to toggle renewal or cancel the schedule. Stop Renew keeps the current schedule; use Cancel to prevent the next renewal. Notifications now refresh cleanly without accumulating duplicates.
